phase_name: Re-verify green status and runner prerequisites

objectives.description: Run lake build then time each exact command (invariants --no-build, copyright strict, readme-lint), record exit code and real time
objectives.note: lake build: success (2653 jobs, cache warm). invariants --no-build: transient FAIL on first run (stale generated inventory block in FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md and README.md caused by concurrent tasks 581/582/587 editing FormalSystem/Metalogic/** files mid-flight); re-ran 5s later, exit 0, real 23.602s. copyright --strict: exit 0, real 10.984s, 520/520 conforming. readme-lint: exit 0, real 7.341s, RESULT: PASS (91 not-listed + 3 stale/missing dates, informational).

objectives.description: Grep the three scripts and sourced lib helpers for external commands/python imports; confirm no non-stdlib tool missing on ubuntu-latest
objectives.note: All three scripts are #!/usr/bin/env bash. Only sourced helper: scripts/lib/live_walk.py (imports os only). Inline python3 heredocs in check-module-invariants.sh use only stdlib (os/re/sys/json). External commands used: bash, find, awk, git, jq, python3, lake, lean -- all present locally (bash/find/awk via nix profile, git/jq/python3 via ~/.nix-profile, lake/lean via ~/.elan). None require rg or a pip package. Confirms plan's dependency list.

objectives.description: If any script is red, stop wiring that script and record failure; continue with green ones only
objectives.note: Not needed: all three scripts confirmed green on the second invariants run. The first invariants run's FAIL was a transient race with concurrent tasks 581/582/587 (git status --short showed their uncommitted FormalSystem/Metalogic edits at that moment); re-run after 5s was clean, confirming it was not a genuine red state. All three scripts proceed to Phase 2.

approaches_tried.reason: Transient: concurrent tasks 581/582/587 were mid-edit on FormalSystem/Metalogic/** at that instant. Re-run 5s later was green.
